entries.en: Halves the fertility lost on harvest.

entries.source: 解锁星辉花；消耗光能播种

entries.zh: 解锁星辉花；消耗光能播种

entries.source: 最终工程：证明农场可以持续自运转

entries.source: 欢迎来到禾湾。先认识你的巡田机器人。

entries.zh: 欢迎来到禾湾。先认识你的巡田机器人。

entries.source: 方向键或 WASD 移动；点击农田也可以导航。

entries.source:
禾序使用一种受 Python 启发的农场语言。它只操作游戏，不会访问电脑文件或网络。

【动作】
move(East) / move(West) / move(North) / move(South)
跨越边界会环绕到另一侧，便于整田扫描。
plant(grain)  播种；harvest()  收获
till()  把空地翻成耕地；water()  浇水
fertilize()  施肥；wait(3)  等待 3 游戏秒
print(表达式)  输出到日志

【传感器】
ready()  当前格是否成熟
crop()  当前作物，空地为 empty
moisture()  水分 0~1；fertility()  肥力 0~1
x() / y()  机器人零起点坐标
size()  农田边长；energy()  光能
count(grain)  作物库存；money()  金币
neighbors(pumpkin)  四邻格同类数量

【语法】
使用四个空格缩进。支持 # 注释、变量、+ - * / %、比较、and / or / not、if / elif / else、while、for ... in range(...)、repeat 4:、无参数 def 函数、break、continue、return。
range() 支持 1~3 个参数。函数在调用前定义；最多嵌套 24 层。

例：
if ready():
    harvest()
else:
    wait(1)

【作物代码】
grain 稻穗 / radish 红萝卜 / flax 蓝亚麻
berry 蓝莓 / sunflower 向日葵 / pumpkin 蜜南瓜
tea 云雾茶 / starbloom 星辉花

【调试】
编辑支持100步撤销/重做：Cmd/Ctrl+Z，Cmd/Ctrl+Shift+Z。程序列表可以增删，最少一个；切换查看不停止当前执行，点击运行会替换正在执行的程序。
运行前会检查语法。错误显示原始行号；当前行也会显示在编辑器下方。暂停后可单步执行，停止后仍保留所有收获。最多执行 500000 条指令后安全停止；无限循环每次都会让出画面更新。

【进度】
作物委托按本任务接取后的新增收获计算，每种作物有不同数量要求；不再设置时间条件。历史库存不会直接抵扣后续作物任务。
委托按累计进度计算，完成后请点击领取。每五份委托开启下一章。作物需要相应研究；科技花费金币与研究点。主线完成后可继续自由经营。

【保存】
程序列表和农场会每 30 秒自动保存，退出时也会保存。手动保存会保留上一份备份。试炼使用独立临时农场，不会消耗主线物资。

【机群】

entries.en:
Verdant Circuit uses a limited farm language inspired by Python. It only controls the game; it does not access your files or the network.

ACTIONS
move(East) / move(West) / move(North) / move(South)
Crossing a field edge wraps to the opposite side.
plant(grain) / harvest() / till() / water() / fertilize()
wait(3) waits for 3 game seconds; print(value) writes to the log.

SENSORS
ready(): whether the current crop is mature
crop(): current crop, or empty
moisture() / fertility(): values from 0 to 1
x() / y(): zero-based robot coordinates
size(): field width; energy(): stored energy
count(grain): current grain stock; money(): coins
neighbors(pumpkin): matching crops in four adjacent plots

SYNTAX
Indent with four spaces. Supports # comments, variables, + - * / %, comparisons, and/or/not, if/elif/else, while, for ... in range(...), repeat, no-argument functions, break, continue and return.
range() accepts 1 to 3 integer arguments. Functions nest up to 24 calls.

if ready():
    harvest()
else:
    wait(1)

CROP IDS
Grain: grain / Radish: radish / Blue flax: flax
Blueberry: berry / Sunflower: sunflower / Pumpkin: pumpkin
Cloud tea: tea / Starbloom: starbloom

EDITOR AND DEBUGGING
Undo/redo up to 100 edits per program in this session: Ctrl/Cmd+Z and Ctrl/Cmd+Shift+Z (or Ctrl+Y).
Add or delete programs in Programs; keep at least one. Viewing another program does not stop the current one. Run replaces the active program.
Syntax and runtime errors show their original source line. Pause and Step help inspect execution. Stop keeps all farm progress. Programs stop safely after 500000 instructions; empty loops yield between frames.

PROGRESS
Crop contracts count harvests after accepting that contract. Each crop has a different quantity target; there is no timer requirement. Earlier stock does not skip later crop contracts.
Other contracts use cumulative progress. Claim rewards to advance; every five contracts opens a chapter. Research costs coins and knowledge. Free farming remains available after the campaign.

SAVE
The farm and program list save every 30 real seconds and on exit. Manual saving keeps the previous backup. Trials use a separate temporary farm and restore the campaign afterward.

LANGUAGE
The first launch uses English. Switch English / Chinese in Settings; the choice is remembered. Existing player code is never translated.

FLEET API
Capacity and airframe size unlock separately. drone_count() counts deployed units; drone_capacity() is the unlocked limit; footprint_tier() is the size level.
deploy_drone("general", 2, 0) deploys a general drone on a free plot. Specialized types are irrigator and harvester, unlocked by research.
drone_id(index) returns a stable ID. drone_x(id), drone_y(id), drone_width(id) and drone_height(id) inspect a unit.
select_drone(id) chooses the directly controlled unit. resize_drone(id, 2, 2) applies an unlocked airframe size if its entire footprint is free.
queue_move(id, x, y), queue_water(id, x, y), queue_harvest(id, x, y) and queue_plant(id, grain, x, y) enqueue work in order.
queue_length(id), drone_busy(id) and can_fit(id, x, y) inspect queues and space. cancel_queue(id) cancels jobs; retire_drone(id) retires a worker.
Queued jobs avoid occupied cells. Direct movement collisions cost 20 coins, at most twice per 10 game seconds. Large airframes do not wrap. Area work charges and harvests each actual plot.
Base drone 0 is free to maintain. Active or waiting workers pay area x role factor every 30 game seconds (general 1, specialist 2). Idle units are free. Unaffordable upkeep pauses work without accumulating debt.
Stop clears queues. Saves preserve queued jobs but reload them paused; resume them from Fleet. Switch languages in Settings or with F8.

8 crops / 30 contracts / 26 research projects / 6 trials / 5 recipes

entries.zh:
内容：8 种作物 · 30 份委托 · 26 项研究 · 6 项试炼 · 5 种加工配方
农场与程序列表会自动保存。

entries.source: 数量与机体规格独立解锁。队列自动寻路避让，直接移动发生碰撞会扣维修费。大型机体不能越界环绕。停止程序会清空队列。

entries.zh: 购置费用随已部署数量增加，部署前检查空闲位置。

entries.source: 只能浇水，需先研究灌溉无人机。
entries.en: Watering only. Requires Irrigation Drone research.
entries.zh: 只能浇水，需先研究灌溉无人机。

entries.source: 只能收获，需先研究收获无人机。
entries.en: Harvesting only. Requires Harvest Drone research.
entries.zh: 只能收获，需先研究收获无人机。

entries.source: 选择已解锁规格。增加占地需要支付改造费用；缩小不退款。
entries.en: Choose an unlocked size. Increasing area costs coins; shrinking does not refund them.
entries.zh: 选择已解锁规格。增加占地需要支付改造费用；缩小不退款。

entries.source: 取消该机的待处理作业。
entries.zh: 取消该机的待处理作业。

entries.source: 须先清空队列，不退购置费用。
entries.en: Clear its queue first. Purchase cost is not refunded.
entries.zh: 须先清空队列，不退购置费用。

entries.source: 0号基础机免维护。其他机体只有执行或等待队列时每30游戏秒收维护费：面积×机型系数，通用为1，专用为2；空闲免费。余额不足时暂停作业，基础机仍可免费种稻穗恢复资金。
entries.en: Base drone 0 has no upkeep. Other drones pay every 30 game seconds only while working or waiting: area x role factor (general 1, specialist 2). Idle drones are free. Insufficient funds pause work; base drone 0 can still grow free grain to restore income.
entries.zh: 0号基础机免维护。其他机体只有执行或等待队列时每30游戏秒收维护费：面积×机型系数，通用为1，专用为2；空闲免费。余额不足时暂停作业，基础机仍可免费种稻穗恢复资金。

entries.source: 完整占地必须空闲、不越界；增加面积会扣费。
entries.en: The entire footprint must be free and in bounds. Expanding costs coins.
entries.zh: 完整占地必须空闲、不越界；增加面积会扣费。

entries.zh: 此无人机有待处理队列，请先取消队列

entries.zh: 方向应为 East / West / North / South

entries.zh: 机体越界：大型机体不能越界环绕

entries.en: Irrigation drones can only water crops.
entries.zh: 浇水无人机只能执行浇水作业

entries.en: Harvest drones can only harvest crops.
entries.zh: 收获无人机只能执行收获作业

entries.zh: 无人机数量已达解锁上限

entries.zh: 机型应为 general / irrigator / harvester

entries.zh: 请先解锁对应无人机机型

entries.zh: 部署位置无效或被占用

entries.zh: 调整机体前请先取消队列

entries.zh: 完整机体占地必须空闲且不越界

entries.zh: 每台无人机最多排队64项任务

entries.zh: 目标超出完整机体可达范围

entries.zh: 队列任务等待超时，已取消；请调整路线

entries.en: Drone index is out of range.

entries.en: English is the default. Switch between English and Simplified Chinese.
entries.zh: 首次启动默认英文，可在英文和简体中文之间切换。

entries.source: 购置费用 {0} 金币。部署前检查空闲位置。
entries.en: Purchase cost: {0} coins. A free location is checked before deployment.
entries.zh: 购置费用 {0} 金币。部署前检查空闲位置。

entries.source: 改造费用 {0} 金币。完整占地必须空闲，规格需已解锁。
entries.en: Upgrade cost: {0} coins. The size must be unlocked and its entire footprint free.
entries.zh: 改造费用 {0} 金币。完整占地必须空闲，规格需已解锁。

entries.source: 欢迎。先收获草获得干草，再解锁种植和扩田。
entries.en: Welcome. Harvest grass to earn hay, then unlock planting and expansion.
entries.zh: 欢迎。先收获草获得干草，再解锁种植和扩田。

entries.source: 请使用不重复的字母、数字、下划线名称。
entries.zh: 请使用不重复的字母、数字、下划线名称。
entries.en: Choose a unique name using letters, digits and underscores.

entries.source: 资源累计与本地成就。竞速使用固定开局，成绩仅保存在本机。
entries.en: Resource totals and local achievements. Challenge records use fixed starts and remain on this computer.
entries.zh: 资源累计与本地成就。竞速使用固定开局，成绩仅保存在本机。

entries.source: 用固定生产目标测试程序。
entries.en: Test a program against a fixed production target.
entries.zh: 用固定生产目标测试程序。

entries.source: 使用选中程序，在独立的 8×8 农场、全部研究、种子 41 和充足种植材料下测试。达标后需让所有工作机结束。最快重置从一格、零物资开始。停止可取消竞速。
entries.zh: 使用选中程序，在独立的 8×8 农场、全部研究、种子 41 和充足种植材料下测试。达标后需让所有工作机结束。最快重置从一格、零物资开始。停止可取消竞速。
entries.en: The selected program is evaluated on a separate 8×8 farm with all research, seed 41 and supplied inputs. Reach the target and let all workers terminate. Fastest reset starts with one plot and no resources. Stop cancels the challenge.

entries.source: 新增生产 1000 份，然后结束程序。
entries.zh: 新增生产 1000 份，然后结束程序。
entries.en: Produce 1000 new units, then terminate the program.

entries.source: 从零开始，通过程序解锁本地竞速研究。
entries.en: Start from zero and unlock local competition through code.
entries.zh: 从零开始，通过程序解锁本地竞速研究。

entries.source: 竞速已在独立农场启动。
entries.en: Challenge started on an isolated farm.
entries.zh: 竞速已在独立农场启动。

entries.source: 竞速超出一小时游戏时间限制。
entries.zh: 竞速超出一小时游戏时间限制。
entries.en: Challenge exceeded the one-hour game-time limit.

entries.source: 竞速结束，尚未达到目标。
entries.en: Challenge ended before reaching its target.
entries.zh: 竞速结束，尚未达到目标。

entries.source: 输出  /  点击地块查看状态，用代码控制无人机。
entries.zh: 输出  /  点击地块查看状态，用代码控制无人机。
entries.en: OUTPUT  /  Click a plot to inspect it. Code controls the drone.

entries.source: Ctrl/Cmd+Enter 运行  /  F8 语言  /  Esc 设置
entries.en: Ctrl/Cmd+Enter: run  /  F8: language  /  Esc: settings
entries.zh: Ctrl/Cmd+Enter 运行  /  F8 语言  /  Esc 设置

entries.source: 科技消耗实际收获物资。新分支引入不同的生产规则。编程功能可逐步学习，也可在设置中允许全部语法。
entries.zh: 科技消耗实际收获物资。新分支引入不同的生产规则。编程功能可逐步学习，也可在设置中允许全部语法。
entries.en: Research uses harvested resources. Unlocking a branch adds new production rules. Programming features can be learned gradually; unrestricted syntax is available in Settings.

entries.source: 程序也是模块：用名称 import 其他文件。切换查看不会停止工作机；运行会启动新的控制程序与独立任务。
entries.zh: 程序也是模块：用名称 import 其他文件。切换查看不会停止工作机；运行会启动新的控制程序与独立任务。
entries.en: Programs are modules: import another file by name. Browsing does not stop running workers. Running starts a new controller and its independent tasks.

entries.source: 使用不重复的标识符，例如 helpers。
entries.zh: 使用不重复的标识符，例如 helpers。
entries.en: Use a unique identifier, for example helpers.

entries.source: 模板用于学习，不会替你完成研究。先解锁所需作物；每个模板会创建为新程序。
entries.en: Templates are examples, not automatic solutions. Unlock the required crops first. Each template opens as a new program.
entries.zh: 模板用于学习，不会替你完成研究。先解锁所需作物；每个模板会创建为新程序。

entries.source: 写代码生产资源，解锁新规则，再测量和优化。先收获起始地块的草；最早的科技开放种植和扩田。
entries.zh: 写代码生产资源，解锁新规则，再测量和优化。先收获起始地块的草；最早的科技开放种植和扩田。
entries.en: Write code, produce resources, unlock new rules, measure and improve. Begin with grass on the starting plot. Planting and expansion come from the first research branch.

entries.source: 语言：变量、条件、循环、带参和返回值函数、列表、元组、集合、字典、global、模块导入与闭包。每层缩进四个空格或一个 Tab。
entries.zh: 语言：变量、条件、循环、带参和返回值函数、列表、元组、集合、字典、global、模块导入与闭包。每层缩进四个空格或一个 Tab。
entries.en: LANGUAGE: variables, if/elif/else, while, for, functions with parameters and returned values, lists, tuples, sets, dictionaries, global, imports and closures. Four spaces or one tab indent each block.

entries.source: 模拟使用独立农场并返回耗时。先创建实验程序，再调用 simulate(名称, 科技, 库存, 全局变量, 种子, 加速)。相同种子复现相同开局，真实农场库存和作物不受影响。
entries.zh: 模拟使用独立农场并返回耗时。先创建实验程序，再调用 simulate(名称, 科技, 库存, 全局变量, 种子, 加速)。相同种子复现相同开局，真实农场库存和作物不受影响。
entries.en: Simulations use a separate farm and return runtime. Add an experiment program, then invoke simulate(name, unlocks, items, globals, seed, speedup). Repeating a seed reproduces the same starting conditions. Live inventory and crop state are preserved.

entries.source: 固定开局、独立农场、记录耗时。成绩保存在本机。
entries.zh: 固定开局、独立农场、记录耗时。成绩保存在本机。
entries.en: Fixed start, measured runtime, separate farm. Records stay on this computer.

entries.source: 英文或简体中文，也可以按 F8 切换。
entries.en: English or Simplified Chinese. F8 also switches languages.
entries.zh: 英文或简体中文，也可以按 F8 切换。

entries.source: 创建全新的自动化农场，当前存档会保留备份。
entries.en: Start a fresh automation farm. Your current save is backed up.
entries.zh: 创建全新的自动化农场，当前存档会保留备份。

entries.source: 用逗号分隔行号。到达断点时暂停所有工作机。
entries.en: Comma-separated line numbers. A matching line pauses every worker.
entries.zh: 用逗号分隔行号。到达断点时暂停所有工作机。

entries.source: 这将创建一格农田、零物资的新开局。
entries.en: This creates a fresh one-plot farm with no resources.
entries.zh: 这将创建一格农田、零物资的新开局。

entries.source: Use indentation in groups of four spaces.
entries.en: Use indentation in groups of four spaces.

格式应为 for 目标 in 序列:

竞速超过一小时游戏时间。

entries.zh: 方向应为 North、East、South 或 West。

entries.en: measure expects at most one direction.
entries.zh: measure 最多接受一个方向。

复制任务内存超过安全限制。

entries.en: Enable unrestricted syntax in Settings to practice.
entries.zh: 可在设置中允许未解锁语法以练习。

entries.source: 请使用不重复的农场名称，仅限英文字母、数字、下划线和短横线。
entries.en: Choose a unique farm name using letters, digits, underscores or hyphens.
entries.zh: 请使用不重复的农场名称，仅限英文字母、数字、下划线和短横线。

entries.source: 每个农场独立保存进度、程序目录、纪录和备份。载入前会保存当前农场并结束执行。

entries.zh: 每个农场独立保存进度、程序目录、纪录和备份。载入前会保存当前农场并结束执行。

entries.source: 名称可用英文字母、数字、下划线和短横线。
entries.en: Use letters, digits, underscores and hyphens.

entries.zh: 条件满足时，让程序自动购买研究。

【生产】
harvest() 收获；can_harvest() 是否成熟
plant(Entities.Grass / Bush / Tree / Carrot / Pumpkin / Sunflower / Cactus)
till() 切换草地与耕地
use_item(Items.Water) 浇水；use_item(Items.Fertilizer) 催熟并感染；合并收获按感染作物比例产出奇异物质
use_item(Items.Weird_Substance) 翻转本格和邻格感染

【观察】
get_pos_x() / get_pos_y() / get_world_size()
get_entity_type() / get_ground_type() / get_water()
num_items(Items.Hay) 查询库存
get_companion() 研究伴生种植后返回类型和目标坐标
measure() 测量花瓣、仙人掌尺寸或目标位置
swap(direction) 交换相邻仙人掌

【移动】
move(North / East / South / West) 返回是否成功
can_move(direction) 预判墙壁及尾巴
普通田地越界环绕，迷宫和长尾模式不能环绕。

【研究】
get_cost(Unlocks.Speed) 查询资源成本
num_unlocked(Unlocks.Speed) 查询研究等级
unlock(Unlocks.Speed) 支付物资完成研究

【并行】
spawn_drone(function, 参数...) 返回任务句柄或 None
wait_for(handle) 等待任务并取得返回值
has_finished(handle) 检查任务是否结束
num_drones() / max_drones()
每台机器具有独立变量与集合副本，农场与库存共享。机器可以位于同一格，不发生实体碰撞。

【实验】

get_time() / get_tick_count() 查询时间与指令计数
set_world_size(size) / set_execution_speed(speed) 用于调试

支持带参函数、默认参数、返回值、闭包、模块导入、列表、元组、集合和字典。
import helpers / from helpers import tend
values.append(3) / visited.add((x,y)) / costs['hay']

程序执行受步骤、集合大小与递归深度限制，无操作系统访问能力。

设置中启用外部编辑器可导出 .py 和接口提示文件，再监视保存的修改。

entries.source:
从一格草地、零库存开始。草会自然成熟，运行 harvest()，攒够五份干草后研究循环，再从模板载入第一份收获。

之后研究运算符、变量、传感器和种植。库存够用不等于自动研究：在科技树点击付费，或后续调用 unlock()。草和灌木不消耗种子，原料用完仍可恢复生产。

本版目标是有可运行自动化策略时，约三小时游戏时间完成全部研究；编程与思考另计。正常 1 倍速保留科技加速，设置中的倍率会加快整个世界。

entries.en:
Start on one grass plot with no inventory. Grass matures naturally. Run harvest() until you own five hay, then research Loops. Load First harvest from Templates.

Next research Operators, Variables, Sensors and Planting. Research does not happen just because you own enough resources: select a node and pay, or later use unlock(). Free grass and bushes provide recovery if you run out of crop seeds.

This campaign aims at about three hours of game time to full research with a working automated strategy. Your planning and editing time is additional. Research speed bonuses are part of normal 1× play; the Settings speed multiplier accelerates the entire world.

entries.source:
程序也是可复用模块。程序库按文件显示卡片，并显示总数、活跃程序数和无人机槽位。绿色表示还有工作机在运行；琥珀色边框表示当前主编辑器打开的文件。同一个程序可以同时处于运行和编辑状态。暂停仍算活跃，空闲表示没有存活工作机。

编辑只切换查看，不会停止已有工作。主运行按钮会替换控制程序及其全部工作机。窗口按钮打开可拖动编辑器，独立运行在有空余槽位时启动文件。全部停止会结束所有任务。关闭编辑窗口不删除代码，也不停止任务；活跃程序不能删除，至少保留一个文件。

Cmd/Ctrl+Z 撤销，Cmd/Ctrl+Shift+Z 重做；F9 在光标行切换断点。用暂停、单步和变量监视定位问题。

entries.en:
Programs are reusable modules. The library shows a card for every file, a total count, active-file count and drone-slot usage. Green means the file has running workers; an amber border means it is open in the main editor. A file may be both running and selected. Paused tasks remain active; idle files have no live workers.

Edit switches the main editor without stopping existing work. Main Run replaces the current controller and its workers. Window opens a draggable editor; Run separately launches that file if a drone slot is free. Stop all terminates every worker. Closing an editor window leaves its code and running tasks intact. Running files cannot be deleted; at least one file is retained.

Use Cmd/Ctrl+Z to undo and Cmd/Ctrl+Shift+Z to redo. F9 toggles a breakpoint at the caret line. Pause, Step and the variable watch help diagnose a program.

entries.source:
解释器采用类 Python 语法，并不是完整 Python 环境。每层缩进四个空格或一个 Tab，不要混用。名称和枚举大小写敏感；变量、条件、函数、集合需要对应语言研究。设置中允许未解锁语法只移除语法门槛，不赠送作物与研究。

支持 if/elif/else、while、for、break/continue、带参函数、默认参数、return、global、模块导入、列表、不可变元组、集合、字典、索引、解包与闭包。不提供 Python 标准库或操作系统访问。比较用 ==，赋值用 =；负索引从末尾计数。

调试可用 print()，频繁输出有执行成本。没有退出条件的 while 会一直运行到点击停止；有限生产任务可按库存设定目标。
entries.en:
The interpreter uses Python-inspired syntax, not a full Python installation. Indent blocks with four spaces or one tab; do not mix them. Names and enum members are case-sensitive. Research the corresponding language nodes before using variables, branches, functions or collections. Unrestricted syntax in Settings removes language gates only; it does not grant crops or research.

Supported forms include if/elif/else, while, for, break/continue, parameterized functions, default arguments, return, global, imports, lists, immutable tuples, sets, dictionaries, indexing, unpacking and closures. Python standard-library modules and operating-system access are unavailable. Compare with ==, assign with =; negative indices count from the end.

Use print() during debugging, but frequent printing adds execution cost. A while loop without an exit continues until Stop; prefer inventory-based goals for finite jobs.

entries.source:
研究分为三种条件：前置发现、累计生产和实际付费。累计生产统计成功收获，即使资源已经花掉也算完成，不会再扣一次；科技树显示当前量与目标。发现新作物后才逐步开放田规模、速度和增产等级。

农田规模：种植→2×2、林木→4×4、南瓜→8×8、仙人掌→16×16、长尾→32×32；每级仍需支付扩田成本。更新保留已购研究，完整体验新进度请新建农场。

get_cost() 查询价格，get_unlock_requirements() 查询门槛，can_unlock() 同时检查门槛和库存。条件不齐时 unlock() 返回 False，不扣资源。没有固定时长认证。下面列出各升级等级所需的发现。
entries.en:
Research has three independent requirements: prior discoveries, cumulative production and a payable resource cost. Production totals count successful harvests even after you spend the resources; they are not a second payment. The tree shows current / required totals. Completing a crop unlocks further field, speed and yield tiers.

Field sizes: Planting → 2×2; Trees → 4×4; Pumpkins → 8×8; Cacti → 16×16; Tail exploration → 32×32. You still pay for each expansion. Existing purchased research is retained when updating; start a new farm to experience the complete staged campaign.

get_cost() reports the price, get_unlock_requirements() reports gates, and can_unlock() checks both gates and funds. unlock() returns False without spending when any requirement is missing. There is no elapsed-time certification gate. The tier lists below identify the discovery needed for each upgrade.

entries.source:
草产干草，灌木与树产木材。胡萝卜需要耕地、干草和木材；南瓜与太阳花消耗胡萝卜，仙人掌消耗南瓜。增产研究也会提高种子成本；铺田前用 get_cost(Entities.Carrot) 查种子价格，并为多轮补种预留原料。

种植要求空格和合适地面，枯死南瓜可直接补种。till() 切换地面；清田和扩田会重置田地、损失在田作物。整田换作物之前先留足库存。

每株相邻树都会进一步拖慢树木生长，推荐树与灌木棋盘交替。普通农田越界环绕，最右列再向东会回到第零列；迷宫和长尾不能环绕。无水基础生长时间：草3秒、灌木4秒、树6秒、胡萝卜7秒、南瓜11秒、太阳花8.5秒、仙人掌1.5秒；浇水会加快生长。
entries.en:
Grass yields hay. Bushes and trees yield wood. Carrots require tilled soil, hay and wood; pumpkins and sunflowers use carrots; cacti use pumpkins. Research increases seed costs as well as yields. Inspect get_cost(Entities.Carrot) before filling a field, and reserve enough inputs for multiple repair cycles.

Planting needs an empty compatible plot; dead pumpkins can be replaced directly. till() switches ground type. Clearing or expanding resets the field and loses standing plants. Protect your inventory before switching the whole field to another crop.

Trees grow more slowly for every adjacent tree, so alternate trees and bushes in a checkerboard. Normal field edges wrap: East from the last column returns to column zero. Maze and tail mode do not wrap. Base growth times are grass 3s, bush 4s, tree 6s, carrot 7s, pumpkin 11s, sunflower 8.5s and cactus 1.5s; water speeds growth.

entries.source:
灌溉研究每十个游戏秒产生水。一份水增加0.25水分，上限1.0，水分会逐渐衰减。仅在水分低于阈值且库存有水时灌溉；如果阈值设为0.3，地块约50%水分时不浇水是预期行为。

肥料同样每十秒自动产生；使用后增加成长并感染本株。合并南瓜或仙人掌收获时，奇异物质按感染株数比例计算，一株感染不会把整田的一半变成奇异物质。肥料催熟也会执行正常南瓜死亡判定。

奇异物质翻转本格及去重后的相邻格感染状态；对灌木使用足量物质会生成迷宫，消耗为边长×2^(迷宫等级−1)；对宝藏使用相同数量会给金币并复用迷宫，最多复用300次。
entries.en:
Irrigation research generates water every ten game seconds. One unit adds 0.25 moisture, up to 1.0; moisture decays gradually. Water only when get_water() is below your chosen threshold and supplies exist. A field near 50% moisture does not need watering under a 0.3 threshold; that is expected.

Fertilizer research generates supplies on the same ten-second cycle. Fertilizer adds growth and infects that plant. When merged pumpkins or cacti are harvested, Weird Substance is proportional to the infected fraction; one infected plant cannot convert half the entire field. Fertilizer also performs the normal pumpkin death check when it reaches maturity.

Weird Substance toggles infection on the current plot and its distinct neighbors. On a bush, enough of it creates a maze instead: side × 2^(maze level−1). On treasure, the same quantity reuses the maze and awards gold, up to 300 reuses.

entries.source:
南瓜在成熟时有20%概率枯死。反复扫描完整方阵，补种 Dead_Pumpkin；修复期间不要单独收割健康南瓜。目标方阵的每一格都成熟后才收获。游戏会合并包含收获点的最大完整方阵。

边长n的产量为 n²×min(n,6)×本级单株产量。要检查整块田，不能只检查脚下一格；预留补种种子。生产奇异物质时，成熟后对需要的株数施肥，再合并收获。累计进度看 num_produced()，可支付库存看 num_items()。
entries.en:
A pumpkin has a 20% chance to die on reaching maturity. Scan the square repeatedly and replace Dead_Pumpkin cells; do not harvest healthy individual plants during repair. Only harvest after every cell in the desired square is a mature pumpkin. The game merges the largest complete square containing the harvest point.

A side n square produces n² × min(n,6) × its per-plant research yield. Check the entire square, not just one ready cell. Budget seeds for replacement. For infection production, apply fertilizer to the number of mature plants you need before harvesting; read num_produced() for milestone progress and num_items() for spendable inventory.

entries.source:
太阳花的 measure() 返回7～15花瓣。田里至少剩十株太阳花时，收获当前最大花瓣可获8倍奖励；先收小花会破坏奖励序列，直到太阳花田清空。只扩种、不测量会损失大部分潜在能量。

先铺田并等成熟，等待时避免来回移动；然后按15到7花瓣分档扫描收获。科技和能量会加速指令，移动与解释执行也消耗能量。不要对每一株都做全田最大值搜索，也不要在等待时把能量全部耗掉。

能量是耗材，并不是永久速度解锁。留下储备和下一轮太阳花所需的胡萝卜。
entries.en:
measure() on a sunflower returns 7–15 petals. If at least ten sunflowers remain, harvesting the current maximum earns an 8× bonus. Picking a smaller flower breaks the bonus sequence until the sunflower field is cleared. Growing more flowers without measuring can waste most of the potential power.

Plant the field, wait for maturity without repeatedly walking, then scan petal values from 15 down to 7. Research and energy accelerate instructions; movement and instruction execution consume power. Avoid endless full-field searches for each individual flower and moving loops that spend all the power while waiting.

Power is a supply, not a permanent speed unlock. Keep a reserve and budget carrot inputs for the next generation of flowers.

entries.source:
研究伴生种植后，get_companion() 返回偏好作物和目标坐标；不适用地块返回 None。草、灌木、树和胡萝卜可提出偏好。原作物收获时，目标坐标需要放着指定类型的作物，伴生本身不用成熟。

先读取并保存偏好，布置伴生，再回到原株成熟后收获。收割补种后偏好可能变化，不要永久缓存。1级为2倍，每级再加0.5，6级达4.5倍；未研究没有伴生加成。

可用字典管理坐标到偏好的映射，处理不同株的需求冲突；盲目覆盖整田会破坏已种作物。
entries.en:
After companion research, get_companion() returns a requested crop and target coordinate, or None for an ineligible plot. Grass, bushes, trees and carrots can request companions. The target must contain the requested type when the original plant is harvested; the companion itself does not have to be mature.

Read and save the request, place the companion, return to the original plant, then harvest when mature. Do not assume a request survives harvesting and replanting. Level 1 multiplies eligible harvests by 2; each additional level adds 0.5, reaching 4.5 at level 6. Before research there is no companion bonus.

For automation, maintain a coordinate-to-request map and resolve conflicting requests; blindly overwriting the whole field often destroys useful crops.

entries.source:
成熟仙人掌的测量尺寸为0～9。swap(East) 或 swap(North) 交换相邻植株。相连成熟区域必须满足向东、向北尺寸均不递减，才能整块连锁；一对逆序就会破坏区域连收。

先排序每一行，再排序每一列。模板的冒泡方法简单可靠；理解不变量后可以优化比较和移动。行排序后再做列排序会保留行间有序性。m株连收产量为本级单株产量×m×min(m,16)，较大有序田仍有收益，倍率不会无限暴涨。

先准备南瓜种子，再清理前一种作物；仅排序尚未成熟的仙人掌仍不能完成连收。
entries.en:
Each mature cactus has a measured size from 0 to 9. swap(East) or swap(North) exchanges adjacent cacti. A connected mature region chains only when sizes are nondecreasing to the east and north. One out-of-order pair prevents the region-wide chain.

Sort every row, then every column. The shipped bubble-sort template is simple and reliable; optimize comparisons and movement when you understand its invariant. Sorting columns after rows preserves the row order. Chain output for m plants is per-plant yield × m × min(m,16), preserving a reward for larger sorted fields with bounded scaling.

Fund pumpkin seeds before clearing the previous crop. Sorting a large field before cacti mature does not satisfy the harvest condition.

先排序每一行，再排序每一列。模板的冒泡方法简单可靠；理解不变量后可以优化比较和移动。行排序后再做列排序会保留行间有序性。m株连收产量为本级单株产量×m×min(m,16)，较大有序田仍有收益，倍率不会无限暴涨。

entries.source:
种一株灌木，使用足量奇异物质生成连通迷宫。can_move() 测墙，move() 返回移动是否成功，measure() 返回宝藏坐标。到宝藏收获金币；误收树篱会清除迷宫，得不到宝藏奖励。

用 visited 集合和方向栈进行深度优先搜索。探索没去过的邻格，走不动时按栈反方向回溯。迷宫复用会拆墙产生环，所以 visited 必不可少。宝藏按照真实通道距离选在足够远的位置，不会重复出现在脚下。

到宝藏后用奇异物质替代 harvest()，会发金币并保留布局、迁移宝藏；清空 visited 再找下一轮。复用消耗材料，最多300次，然后收获并重新生成迷宫。
entries.en:
Plant a bush, then use Weird Substance in the required quantity to generate a connected maze. can_move() tests walls, move() reports success, and measure() returns the treasure coordinate. Harvest at treasure for gold. Harvesting a hedge clears the maze without a treasure reward.

Use depth-first search with a visited set and a direction stack. Explore unvisited neighbors; when stuck, reverse the last move. For reusable mazes, a visited set is essential because walls can be removed and loops appear. Treasure targets are chosen far enough along the actual passages, not at the current tile.

At treasure, use Weird Substance instead of harvesting to receive gold and relocate the target while preserving the layout. Re-search using a fresh visited set. Reuse consumes supplies and is limited to 300 relocations; afterwards harvest and generate a new maze.

entries.source:
恐龙帽开启苹果与长尾模式。苹果消耗仙人掌库存，尾巴占据地块、禁止穿越，田边不再环绕。can_move() 与 move() 遵守占用规则；在苹果处 measure() 可得到下一目标。一次只有一台无人机能控制长尾。

偶数边长空田可使用哈密顿回路：无交叉地走遍每格，再沿第一列返回。持续跟随回路，比贪心冲向每个苹果更安全。至少准备边长²+1份仙人掌，停止或换回草帽即可结算当前尾巴。

骨头=floor(尾长×min(尾长,64)×(1+0.25×(研究等级−1)))。长度超过64仍增加产量，但长度倍率封顶。模板会在满路线受阻后结束。
entries.en:
The Dinosaur Hat enables the apple-and-tail mode. Apples consume cactus inventory. The tail occupies cells, prevents crossing itself, and disables field wrapping. can_move() and move() obey tail occupancy; measure() at the apple provides the next target. Only one drone can control the tail.

An even-sided empty field supports a Hamiltonian cycle: cover every tile along a nonintersecting route and return along the first column. Follow the cycle instead of greedily heading for each apple. Keep at least side²+1 cactus available. Stop or switch to Straw_Hat to settle the current tail.

Bone = floor(length × min(length,64) × (1 + 0.25×(research level−1))). After length 64, each extra segment still adds production, while the length multiplier stays bounded. The template ends when its full route becomes blocked.

并行研究将容量从1提升到2、4、8、16、32；主控制程序也占槽位。spawn_drone(function,参数...) 返回句柄，槽满返回 None。工作机拿到独立变量和集合副本，但共享田地和库存，可以同格移动，不发生实体碰撞。

按列或分区工作，避免两台机器同时在一格种植、争抢种子。保存句柄，再逐个 wait_for() 取返回值；has_finished() 不等待只查询。工作机修改 global 不会改变控制程序副本，请用 return 传递结果。完成后槽位会释放。

生成失败时由主控制程序接手任务。达标后仍有工作机不停执行的程序不能完成资源竞速。
entries.en:
Parallel research raises capacity from 1 to 2, 4, 8, 16 and 32. The main controller uses a slot. spawn_drone(function,args...) returns a handle or None if capacity is full. Workers get independent copies of variables and collections, but share the field and inventory. They can occupy the same cell without collision.

Use per-column or per-region jobs to avoid two workers planting the same plot or racing for seeds. Save handles, then wait_for() each result. has_finished() checks without waiting. Modifying a worker's global variable does not update the controller's copy; return a value instead. Completed workers release slots.

When spawning fails, let the main controller perform the job. A program that never joins or terminates its workers will not finish a resource competition.

entries.source:
创建名为 experiment 的程序。simulate(名称,科技,库存,全局变量,种子,加速) 在独立农场运行，返回游戏秒。Unlocks 代表全部科技，也可用字典指定等级；传入库存和全局变量是独立副本。重复非负种子可复现初始随机性，真实库存和作物不受影响。模拟最多一小时游戏时间，不支持嵌套。

资源竞速使用种子41、中阶8×8农场，提供原料。目标分别为：干草4096、木材6000、胡萝卜2048、南瓜12000、能量8000、仙人掌20000、金币4096、骨头30000；需要达标并结束全部工作机。_Single 类别只允许一台。资源竞速上限一小时；最快重置从零开局，上限四小时，通过程序买下本地竞速研究后结束。

成绩仅保存在本机。旧规则成绩标为历史，不与当前成绩比较。成就和竞速完成后弹窗提示，未读提示重启保留，不向 Steam 在线榜提交。
entries.en:
Create a module named experiment. simulate(name,unlocks,items,globals,seed,speedup) runs a separate farm and returns game seconds. Unlocks means all research; dictionaries can select research levels. Input items and globals are isolated copies. Repeating a nonnegative seed reproduces the same initial randomness. Actual inventory and crops are unchanged. A simulation is capped at one game hour; nested simulations are unsupported.

Resource competitions use a standard 8×8 mid-tier farm and seed 41 with supplied inputs. Targets differ: hay 4096, wood 6000, carrots 2048, pumpkins 12000, power 8000, cactus 20000, gold 4096, bone 30000. Produce the target AND terminate all workers. _Single categories restrict capacity to one. Resource challenges allow one game hour; Fastest_Reset starts from zero and allows four, ending when local competition research is purchased.

Records stay on this computer. Old-rule scores are marked historical and are not compared with current scores. Achievements and successful challenges open a completion notice; unread notices survive restarting. There is no online Steam submission.

物资够却研究不了：查看下一级所需作物发现和累计产量。执行速度与增产现在不能一次全部开放。

南瓜不能合并：检查每格是否枯死或未成熟。仙人掌不连收：找向东/北逆序或未成熟格。能量耗光：减少重复移动与扫描。迷宫卡住：使用 visited 和回溯，迷宫没有普通环绕。无人机 global 不返回：用 wait_for() 接收返回值。

用F9断点、暂停和单步逐行检查；语法错误带行号。备份文件以 .bak 结尾。农场库创建独立存档及程序目录。外部编辑器会导出 .py 和 __builtins__.py 提示并监视保存，避免两处同时改同一文件。音量滑条松开时保存。

更新后测试完整进度建议新建农场。旧规则获得的资源不会被追回。
entries.en:
Crop never appears: check its research, seed inventory, soil and whether the cell is empty. A failed plant() returns False; waiting on an empty plot cannot mature it.

Research stays locked with enough funds: read the next-level crop discovery and cumulative-production requirements. Speed and yield tiers no longer all unlock together.

Pumpkins never merge: inspect every cell for dead or immature plants. Cactus chains fail: find an east/north inversion or an immature member. Power disappears: stop repeated walking and reduce scans. Maze gets stuck: use visited and backtracking; normal wrapping does not apply. Drone globals do not return: use wait_for() return values.

Use F9 breakpoints, Pause and Step to inspect one line at a time. Syntax errors include line numbers. Save backups end with .bak. Farm Library creates independent saves and program folders. External editor mode exports .py and __builtins__.py hints, then watches saves; avoid editing a file in two editors simultaneously. Audio level is saved when you release the slider.

Full progression after an update is best tested on a new farm. Updating does not take back resources earned under earlier balance rules.

entries.en:
All public game APIs are listed below with prerequisites and return values. Entities, Items, Grounds, Unlocks, Hats and Leaderboards are namespaces. Calls are case-sensitive. Successful research is paid from shared inventory. A cost may exist even when its discovery or production requirements are unmet. A fully researched node returns None for cost and requirements.

Examples in other chapters may be fragments intended for an existing field or loop; each chapter names its assumptions. Templates provide complete algorithms for the major crop mechanics.

程序名称支持数字或汉字开头，例如123、1号农场、浇水程序。允许汉字、字母、数字和下划线，最多80字符，不填.py。重复名称（含仅大小写不同）不能创建。数字文件可用 from 123 import work 或 import 123 as farm；中文文件可直接 import 浇水程序。

程序也是可复用模块。程序库按文件显示卡片，并显示总数、活跃程序数和无人机槽位。绿色表示还有工作机在运行；琥珀色边框表示当前主编辑器打开的文件。同一个程序可以同时处于运行和编辑状态。暂停仍算活跃，空闲表示没有存活工作机。

Cmd/Ctrl+Z 撤销，Cmd/Ctrl+Shift+Z 重做；F9 在光标行切换断点。用暂停、单步和变量监视定位问题。
entries.en:
Program names may start with Chinese characters or digits: 123, 1_farm and 浇水程序 are valid. Use letters, digits or underscores, up to 80 characters, without .py. Duplicate names, including case-only variants, are rejected. Import a numeric file with from 123 import work or import 123 as farm. Chinese module names work directly, for example import 浇水程序.

Programs are reusable modules. The library shows a card for every file, a total count, active-file count and drone-slot usage. Green means the file has running workers; an amber border means it is open in the main editor. A file may be both running and selected. Paused tasks remain active; idle files have no live workers.

Edit switches the main editor without stopping existing work. Main Run replaces the current controller and its workers. Window opens a draggable editor; Run separately launches that file if a drone slot is free. Stop all terminates every worker. Closing an editor window leaves its code and running tasks intact. Running files cannot be deleted; at least one file is retained.

Use Cmd/Ctrl+Z to undo and Cmd/Ctrl+Shift+Z to redo. F9 toggles a breakpoint at the caret line. Pause, Step and the variable watch help diagnose a program.

entries.en:
Open Islands after discovering Carrots. The charter costs 100 Wood and 100 Carrots, and grants 100 fleet credits once. Island machines are separate from the legacy 1–32 crop-script workers. Three independent research tracks govern fleet slots (3–8), hull footprint (1×1, 2×1, 2×2, 3×2, 3×3, including rotated variants), and specialisms. A larger hull processes a larger batch and carries more, but moves more slowly and must fit every occupied cell. Irrigators pump water; growers produce grain or medicine; engineers mine and refine ore/alloy or assemble cores; scouts refine crystal; haulers move cargo; harvesters accelerate grain production.

Orders pay fleet credits. Each role and hull has an explicit order gate. Dismantling a landed machine returns its full paid hull cost; cancellation refunds reserved recipe inputs and uncollected cargo. In-flight machines must land before cancellation or dismantling. Automatic routes wait without fees; unsafe manual fleet_step moves trigger an emergency brake and a bounded repair fee. A footprint never overlaps another machine. Avoid blocking ports with manually parked machines.

entries.source:
六座岛的独立仓库构成生产图：炉心种谷物；苇泽供水；余烬用矿石＋谷物＋水冶炼合金；琉光用合金＋水提炼晶体；花汐用谷物＋晶体＋水生产药剂；天穹把合金＋晶体＋药剂组装为核心。岛屿同时要求订单进度与主农场发现：胡萝卜／南瓜／仙人掌／迷宫／长尾／自治信标。库存按岛独立，num_items(Items.Water) 不等于 fleet_stock(岛屿,"water")。

用 fleet_map 查询各岛地图与连接图。宽通道组成向东／向西的单向环路；小机体可穿窄道。货运指令接受时预留真实源仓库存，运输机再前往码头装货，沿连接航道逐段航行，并等待完整占地可降落。已预留和在途货物不能重复投入配方或订单。

18单要求多个品类、多个目的地同时备齐，全部交付只扣一次列明的本地库存。后续任务还认证实际机体作业、不同子程序并发和同时航行；清单会显示本单峰值与目标。没有按秒数放行的认证。群岛流程衔接主农场；编辑、排错与交错生产会改变总通关时间。
entries.en:
Six local depots form a production graph: Hearth grows grain; Reed supplies water; Ember turns ore + grain + water into alloy; Glass needs alloy + water for crystal; Bloom needs grain + crystal + water for medicine; Zenith combines alloy + crystal + medicine into cores. Island opening requires both its order discovery and the corresponding main-farm discovery: Carrots / Pumpkins / Cactus / Mazes / Dinosaurs / Autonomy beacon. Goods are local: num_items(Items.Water) is not fleet_stock(island,"water").

Use fleet_map to inspect each island and its graph. Broad channels form an eastbound/westbound loop; small machines can use narrow shortcuts. Shipments reserve real source stock when accepted, then a physical hauler travels to a dock, loads its hold, crosses each connected channel and waits for a complete landing footprint. Reserved cargo and cargo in flight are not available for another recipe or order.

18 orders require several products and destinations simultaneously. Deliver all consumes the listed local stock once. Later briefs also certify actual hull use, distinct concurrent programs and simultaneous flights; their checklists show current peaks and required values. No elapsed-time certification is used. The six-island campaign follows the farming campaign; editing, debugging and optimal overlapping production can change total completion time.

六座岛的独立仓库构成生产图：炉心种谷物；苇泽供水；余烬用矿石＋谷物＋水冶炼合金；琉光用合金＋水提炼晶体；花汐用谷物＋晶体＋水生产药剂；天穹把合金＋晶体＋药剂组装为核心。岛屿同时要求订单进度与主农场发现：胡萝卜／南瓜／仙人掌／迷宫／长尾／自治信标。库存按岛独立，num_items(Items.Water) 不等于 fleet_stock(岛屿,"water")。

18单要求多个品类、多个目的地同时备齐，全部交付只扣一次列明的本地库存。后续任务还认证实际机体作业、不同子程序并发和同时航行；清单会显示本单峰值与目标。没有按秒数放行的认证。群岛流程衔接主农场；编辑、排错与交错生产会改变总通关时间。

Use the Islands screen to create the 10-file modular example. island_controller imports island_planner; the coordinator allocates physical machines, expands recipe dependencies and sends jobs to individual inboxes. fleet_worker is a shared function library. entries.source: 读取独立数量／尺寸／类型进度、多目标订单与实体机快照，含在途货运、在制品、代码错误和收件箱数量。

entries.en: Read independent slot/size/role progress, current multi-goal contract and physical agents. Unit snapshots include incoming shipments, pending production, code errors and inbox size.

entries.source: 本地可用库存，不含已接受货运的预留。货物用字符串：water、grain、ore、alloy、crystal、medicine、core。
entries.zh: 本地可用库存，不含已接受货运的预留。货物用字符串：water、grain、ore、alloy、crystal、medicine、core。
entries.en: Available local stock, excluding accepted shipping reservations. Cargo names are strings: water, grain, ore, alloy, crystal, medicine, core.

entries.source: 从下到上的地图行、配方、类型要求、坐标和岛屿连接；岛屿编号0—5。
entries.zh: 从下到上的地图行、配方、类型要求、坐标和岛屿连接；岛屿编号0—5。
entries.en: Terrain rows from bottom to top, recipes, role requirements, coordinates and island links. Island IDs are 0–5.

entries.source: 支付资金，分别检查类型、机体、槽位与停机空间；支持旋转尺寸。
entries.zh: 支付资金，分别检查类型、机体、槽位与停机空间；支持旋转尺寸。
entries.en: Pays credits and respects independent role, hull, slot and parking-space limits. Rotated hulls are supported.

entries.zh: 达到订单发现后支付机队资金；增加数量不会扩大机体。
entries.en: Pay fleet credits after the named order discovery. Buying slots does not enlarge a hull.

entries.source: 排入类型匹配的本地配方；每批原料与产出按机体面积计算，加工开始时预留原料。
entries.zh: 排入类型匹配的本地配方；每批原料与产出按机体面积计算，加工开始时预留原料。
entries.en: Queue a role-compatible local recipe. One batch scales inputs and outputs by occupied area; inputs reserve when processing begins.

entries.zh: 仅运输机。原子预留源仓可用库存，再真实装货、航行与卸货，不会瞬移物资。
entries.en: Haulers only. Atomically reserves available source stock, then physically loads, flies and unloads; no instant cargo transfer.

entries.source: 排入跨岛移动或本岛路径，检查地形、单向通道和全部机体占地。
entries.zh: 排入跨岛移动或本岛路径，检查地形、单向通道和全部机体占地。
entries.en: Queue inter-island travel or a local route. Terrain, lane direction and every occupied hull cell are checked.

entries.source: 查询考虑地形的本岛路径；实际通行还可能因实时占地而等待或绕行。
entries.zh: 查询考虑地形的本岛路径；实际通行还可能因实时占地而等待或绕行。
entries.en: Inspect a terrain-aware local path. Live reservations can make actual execution wait or reroute.

entries.source: 仅空闲机。危险移动失败触发急停，维修费不超过2资金；旋转后须能完整放下。
entries.zh: 仅空闲机。危险移动失败触发急停，维修费不超过2资金；旋转后须能完整放下。
entries.en: Idle machines only. Failed unsafe steps trigger emergency braking and at most two credits in fees. Rotation must fit.

entries.source: 仅已降落机。退回预留原料与未提取货物，拆解另返还机体价格。
entries.zh: 仅已降落机。退回预留原料与未提取货物，拆解另返还机体价格。
entries.en: Landed machines only. Refund reserved inputs and uncollected manifests; dismantling also refunds the hull cost.

entries.source: 满足机体／程序／航行清单后，一次性扣除本单全部目标物资，奖励资金并开放下一单。
entries.zh: 满足机体／程序／航行清单后，一次性扣除本单全部目标物资，奖励资金并开放下一单。
entries.en: Consumes all current contract goals once, after hull/program/flight checklist conditions are met; rewards credits and discovers the next order.

entries.source: 为实体机启动独立文件解释器，或停止代码；停止代码不会取消已排入的物理工作。
entries.zh: 为实体机启动独立文件解释器，或停止代码；停止代码不会取消已排入的物理工作。
entries.en: Start an independent named-file interpreter or stop code. Stop does not cancel already queued physical work.

entries.source: 单机子程序内返回绑定机体编号；主控制器中返回-1。
entries.zh: 单机子程序内返回绑定机体编号；主控制器中返回-1。
entries.en: Bound physical machine ID inside a fleet program; -1 in the main controller.

entries.source: 向容量16的收件箱发送值副本；非阻塞接收，空时返回None；单机程序只接收本机消息。
entries.zh: 向容量16的收件箱发送值副本；非阻塞接收，空时返回None；单机程序只接收本机消息。
entries.en: Send a copied value to a bounded 16-message inbox. Receive is nonblocking and returns None when empty; only bound workers receive their own inbox.

entries.source: 读取已结束子程序的result变量副本；结果为临时数据，不写存档。
entries.zh: 读取已结束子程序的result变量副本；结果为临时数据，不写存档。
entries.en: Read a copied result variable from a finished program; transient and not saved.

entries.source: 让出当前调用者，让物理队列和其他程序推进；范围0—3600，不是解锁计时条件。
entries.zh: 让出当前调用者，让物理队列和其他程序推进；范围0—3600，不是解锁计时条件。
entries.en: Yield the caller while physical queues and other programs advance; range 0–3600. Not an unlock timer.

entries.source: 研究与全部18单群岛订单均已完成。
entries.en: Research and all 18 island orders complete.
entries.zh: 研究与全部18单群岛订单均已完成。

entries.source: 签署开拓许可，连接六岛生产链。
entries.en: Sign the charter and connect six local production chains.
entries.zh: 签署开拓许可，连接六岛生产链。

entries.zh: 代码已停止。活跃总控可能重启它；手动接管前请先全部停止。

entries.source:
从一格草地、零库存开始。草会自然成熟，运行 harvest()，攒够五份干草后研究循环，再从模板载入第一份收获。

之后研究运算符、变量、传感器和种植。库存够用不等于自动研究：在科技树点击付费，或后续调用 unlock()。草和灌木不消耗种子，原料用完仍可恢复生产。

本版目标是有可运行自动化策略时，约三小时游戏时间完成全部研究；0.12.1另有多小时的六岛物流流程，可以与研究路线交错推进；编程与思考另计。正常 1 倍速保留科技加速，设置中的倍率会加快整个世界。
entries.en:
Start on one grass plot with no inventory. Grass matures naturally. Run harvest() until you own five hay, then research Loops. Load First harvest from Templates.

Next research Operators, Variables, Sensors and Planting. Research does not happen just because you own enough resources: select a node and pay, or later use unlock(). Free grass and bushes provide recovery if you run out of crop seeds.

This campaign aims at about three hours of game time to full research with a working automated strategy. 0.12.1 adds the multi-hour six-island logistics campaign after and alongside this research route. Your planning and editing time is additional. Research speed bonuses are part of normal 1× play; the Settings speed multiplier accelerates the entire world.

发现胡萝卜后打开群岛。开拓许可消耗100木材与100胡萝卜，一次性提供100机队资金。群岛实体机与原有1—32台脚本工作机独立。数量（3—8）、机体占地（1×1、2×1、2×2、3×2、3×3，可旋转）和专用类型分别研究。大机体能加工更大批次、运输更多物资，但移动较慢，每个占地格都必须可通行。灌溉机抽水；种植机生产谷物或药剂；工程机采矿、冶炼矿石／合金或组装核心；侦察机提炼晶体；运输机搬运货物；采收机加快谷物生产。

订单奖励机队资金，类型和尺寸有明确的订单门槛。维修费导致缺钱时，可以fleet_sell出口富余库存恢复资金，不能出售已预留货单。拆解已降落机体返还全部机体价格；取消队列退回已预留配方原料和未提取货物。航行中的机体须先降落才能取消或拆解。自动路径等待不收费；危险的手动 fleet_step 会触发急停和有限维修费。机体不会重叠。手动停机时请勿堵住码头。

订单奖励机队资金，类型和尺寸有明确的订单门槛。维修费导致缺钱时，可以fleet_sell出口富余库存恢复资金，不能出售已预留货单。拆解已降落机体返还全部机体价格；取消队列退回已预留配方原料和未提取货物。航行中的机体须先降落才能取消或拆解。自动路径等待不收费；危险的手动 fleet_step 会触发急停和有限维修费。机体不会重叠。手动停机时请勿堵住码头。
entries.en:
Open Islands after discovering Carrots. The charter costs 100 Wood and 100 Carrots, and grants 100 fleet credits once. Island machines are separate from the legacy 1–32 crop-script workers. Three independent research tracks govern fleet slots (3–8), hull footprint (1×1, 2×1, 2×2, 3×2, 3×3, including rotated variants), and specialisms. A larger hull processes a larger batch and carries more, but moves more slowly and must fit every occupied cell. Irrigators pump water; growers produce grain or medicine; engineers mine and refine ore/alloy or assemble cores; scouts refine crystal; haulers move cargo; harvesters accelerate grain production.

Orders pay fleet credits. Each role and hull has an explicit order gate. Export surplus depot goods with fleet_sell to recover credits after repair penalties; exports consume real available goods and cannot sell reserved manifests. Dismantling a landed machine returns its full paid hull cost; cancellation refunds reserved recipe inputs and uncollected cargo. In-flight machines must land before cancellation or dismantling. Automatic routes wait without fees; unsafe manual fleet_step moves trigger an emergency brake and a bounded repair fee. A footprint never overlaps another machine. Avoid blocking ports with manually parked machines.

程序中心将文件和执行目标分开。先选择地球农务机、联合总控、岛屿管理、指定单机或机群，再选择文件。编辑只切换查看；“仅绑定”保存目标与文件的关系并停止目标旧代码；“绑定并运行”从头启动文件。同一台机、同一岛管理或联合总控最多运行一个解释器，不同目标可以并行。

绿色卡片表示活跃，琥珀边框表示正在编辑，绑定标签显示目标编号。正在运行的文件和它导入的库不能删除，至少保留一个文件。支持中文和数字开头命名，导入不填.py。

主工作台目标条显示运行按钮将影响谁，浮动编辑器也使用此目标。“停止此目标”保留其他运行；“全部停止”结束总控、管理和单机代码，并取消落地实体任务。保留撤销、重做、多窗口与外部编辑器。
entries.en:
The program center separates files from execution targets. Choose Earth farmer, Network, Island manager, a specific drone or a named group. Edit changes only the file being viewed. Bind only saves a target association and stops its old code; Bind + run starts the selected file on that target. One drone, island or network target has at most one active interpreter. Different targets run concurrently.

Green cards are active, amber borders mark the edited file, and binding labels list target IDs. Files used by a running program or imported library cannot be deleted. At least one file remains. Chinese and numeric names are accepted; imports use the file name without .py.

The studio target strip shows what Run affects. Floating editors also run on this selected target. Stop target leaves other targets running; Stop all stops managers, workers and landed physical work. Undo/redo, independent editor windows and external editing remain available.

entries.source:
地球农务机执行原有作物函数，操作同一片地球农田和原有库存，每台有独立坐标与变量。持久工作机通过fleet_build建造，再用program_bind、program_run绑定运行；原有spawn_drone(函数,参数...)在地球农务程序中创建临时子机，结束释放槽位，wait_for取得返回值。

机群用group_create(名称,[编号...])创建，再group_run(名称,文件)。各成员独立执行同一文件，通过fleet_self识别自身，不共享可变变量，协作需消息通信。管理程序不占实体无人机名额。农务机为1×1；专用机使用已研究的矩形实体通行。地球作物网格保留原有飞行器可跨越同格的规则。
entries.en:
Earth farmers run original crop functions against the same Earth field and inventory. Each bound farmer has its own coordinates and variables. Permanent workers are created with fleet_build and bound with program_bind/program_run. Legacy spawn_drone(function,args...) creates a temporary farmer from an Earth worker; completion releases its slot and wait_for returns its value.

For groups use group_create(name,[ids...]) and group_run(name,file). Members execute independent copies of the file; fleet_self identifies the current member. They do not share mutable variables. Use inbox messages to coordinate. Managers consume no physical drone slot. Farmer bodies are 1×1; specialist hulls use the researched rectangular traffic system. Earth crop workers retain the original overflight behavior on the crop grid.

The API uses positional arguments only. Examples mentioning drone_id or hauler require an existing machine ID. Files must already exist in Programs.

Inventory calls return available stock. Unit snapshots expose job counts, cargo, flight status, program state and errors.

Entities选择地球原有作物，Items选择库存物资，Unlocks选择科技，不能把科技名当种子。North/East/South/West表示方向，Grounds表示地面，Hats表示外观或探索行为，Leaderboards表示本地竞速类别。

在fleet_stock、fleet_ship、product_info中可用物资标识字符串。Items.Rose等价于'rose'，Items.Gold_Ore等价于'gold_ore'；Items.Gold仍是宝藏金币。岛号固定：地球0，物流据点1～5，花卉6、矿物7、鱼类8；机号单独分配，不是岛号。

entries.en:
Entities selects original Earth crops; Items selects inventory resources; Unlocks selects research, never a crop seed. North/East/South/West are directions, Grounds selects terrain, Hats selects appearance or exploration behavior, and Leaderboards selects local race categories.

Use string cargo IDs with fleet_stock, fleet_ship and product_info. Items.Rose is equivalent to 'rose', Items.Gold_Ore to 'gold_ore', while Items.Gold remains treasure currency. Island IDs are stable: Earth 0; logistics outposts 1–5; Flowers 6, Minerals 7, Fish 8. Drone IDs are allocated separately and are not island IDs.

Save stores physical inventory, jobs, reservations, bindings, groups and unread notices. Call stacks, messages and results are transient. Existing home and island-0 warehouses merge once on upgrade. Back up your farm before comparing old versions.

在fleet_stock、fleet_ship、product_info中可用物资标识字符串。Items.Rose等价于'rose'，Items.Gold_Ore等价于'gold_ore'；Items.Gold仍是宝藏金币。岛号固定：地球0，物流据点1～5，花卉6、矿物7、鱼类8；机号单独分配，不是岛号。

存档保存实体库存、任务、预留货物、绑定、机群和未读提示；调用栈、消息、结果为临时数据。升级时旧地球和旧0号岛库存只合并一次。与旧版本比较前请备份农场。

entries.source:
所有持久机体统一出现在机队列表中，包括地球农务机。容量由已购并行无人机科技和机队数量研究共同决定，数量、机体面积、角色分别研究。大机体的原料和产量按面积放大，耗时增幅较慢，但需要更宽的通道。

每机实体队列最多64项。宽桥采用单向环路，小机体可抄窄道，码头与降落检查整个占地。危险手动步进可能扣维修费；自动路径会等待、避让，不允许重叠。工程机由第6单或矿物岛科技开放，采收／渔业机由第7单或鱼类岛科技开放。配方需要正确机型。
entries.en:
All persistent machines appear in one fleet list, including Earth farmers. Slot capacity follows purchased parallel-drone research and fleet slot upgrades. Count, hull area and role research are independent. A bigger machine scales recipe inputs and output by area; duration scales more slowly, but the body needs wider lanes.

Physical jobs are queued, up to 64 per drone. Broad passages use a one-way loop, smaller hulls can take narrow shortcuts, and docking/landing reserves the full footprint. Unsafe manual movement may incur repair fees; automatic routes wait or yield rather than overlap. Engineer research opens after order 6 or Mineral Island; harvester after order 7 or Fish Island. Ordinary recipe work requires its assigned role.

entries.source:
在程序中心创建统一控制范例，把unified_controller绑定到联合总控。它启动earth_manager以及已开放的花卉、矿物、鱼类管理程序后结束，管理和单机继续独立运行。每岛最多一个管理程序，每台机持久保存自己的文件绑定。重复运行管理程序会复用匹配机体，也可能重启该机，因此派工前应检查已有队列。

专用子程序导入production_helpers，空闲时只排一批。先安排真实补给：玫瑰需要水与堆肥，鲤鱼需要干草与水。名额用尽时管理程序无法建造，要先释放名额、研究数量或重新分配机体。范例用来学习分层控制，不会自动完成全部订单。

实体队列、在途货物、文件绑定和机群成员会保存；解释器调用栈、收件箱、结果不保存。载入后重新启动需要的总控，停止父程序不会递归停止子程序。单机报错只停自身，可在卡片和program_state查看；单次执行预算防止死循环拖住其他解释器。
entries.en:
Create the unified example from Programs. Bind unified_controller to Network. It starts earth_manager and the unlocked flower/mineral/fish managers, then terminates. The managers and workers continue independently. Each island has at most one manager; every drone keeps its own file binding. Re-running a manager reuses a matching drone and may restart that worker, so inspect existing jobs before adding work.

Specialist workers import production_helpers and enqueue one batch when idle. Arrange real deliveries first: rose needs water and compost, carp needs hay and water. Managers may fail to build if all slots are occupied; free a slot, research more capacity or reassign a machine. The example teaches hierarchy and does not automatically complete every order.

Physical queues, cargo and bindings are saved. Interpreter stacks, inboxes and results are not. After loading, restart the appropriate controller; stopping a parent does not recursively stop children. Worker errors are isolated, shown on its card and program_state. CPU budgets keep a tight loop from freezing other interpreters.

地球0号岛使用原有库存，没有第二份仓库。fleet_stock(0,'wood')与num_items(Items.Wood)查询一致。订单、出口、作物种子与科研都使用同一份可用地球资源。运输接单即预留货物，分舱实际航行，到达后只卸货一次；特色产物运回地球就进入原有母港库存。

保留原有五座物流据点作为过渡。新增科技分支分别开放芳华6号、鎏金7号和沧澜8号，三者可独立解锁。用world_islands检查unlocked，不要认为“小于开放数量”的编号都能进入。原物流订单后增加六产物订单与跨岛循环订单，最终向地球联合交付。
entries.en:
Earth (0) uses the original inventory, not a second warehouse. fleet_stock(0,'wood') and num_items(Items.Wood) agree. Orders, exports, crop planting and research compete for the same available Earth resources. Transport reserves stock at acceptance, carries limited holds across actual flights, and unloads once. Returning an island product to Earth makes it available in the original home inventory.

The five original logistics outposts remain as stepping stones. Three new research branches open Floralia (6), Aurelia (7) and Pelagia (8) independently. Query world_islands and check unlocked; do not assume all numbers below the unlocked count are open. New six-product contracts follow the original logistics orders, ending with synchronized returns to Earth.

entries.en:
1. Enter Earth; complete the original crop and language discoveries.
2. Research Parallel Drones, Modules, Dictionaries and Irrigation. Purchase Earth & archipelago network for 500 treasure gold. There is no second charter fee.
3. Research Flower Island (2000 pumpkin), Mineral Island (5000 cactus), or Fish Island (20000 carrot). The branches are independent.
4. Build the appropriate specialist and a hauler, respecting slot capacity.
5. Bind and run programs; transport real inputs before waiting for outputs.
6. Return products to Earth, complete orders and expand the network.

entries.source:
直接调用：管理程序grow_rose(机号,4)。单机绑定：program_bind(机号,'rose_worker')，再program_run(机号)。机群调用：group_create('team',[a,b])，再group_run('team','worker')。模块导入：import production_helpers，每个解释器有独立模块变量。消息调用：fleet_send(机号,数据)，子程序fleet_receive接收。结果调用：有限子程序设置result，外部fleet_result(机号)读取。

不同产物可绑定不同文件，或同一文件按fleet_self/island_self分支，或通过消息接收目标配方。循环链从基础鲤鱼、薰衣草开始，之后做荷花、锦鲤；黄金矿料需要青铜和白银，铂金需要玫瑰，钻石需要兰花。

缺料时检查product_info、岛仓库存、已预留量、机型和岛屿解锁。堵塞时检查完整机体占地和码头，改派前取消已落地队列。若管理程序不停重启子机，先停管理程序或全部停止，再手动重绑定。
entries.en:
Direct: call grow_rose(id,4) from a manager. Bound: program_bind(id,'rose_worker'), then program_run(id). Group: group_create('team',[a,b]), then group_run('team','worker'). Module: import production_helpers; each interpreter gets its own module variables. Message: fleet_send(id, payload), then fleet_receive inside that worker. Results: assign result in a finite worker and read fleet_result(id).

For mixed products, bind different files, branch on fleet_self/island_self, or receive a message with the requested recipe. A productive circular chain starts with basic carp and lavender before lotus and koi; gold_ore needs bronze and silver, platinum needs roses, diamonds need orchids.

If production waits: check product_info inputs, local stock, reservations, the correct role and unlocked island. If traffic waits: inspect hull footprint and docking; cancel landed jobs before reassigning. If a manager keeps restarting a worker, stop the manager or Stop all before editing assignments.

entries.en: Original crop discoveries gate Earth expansion, speed and yield. The last four Earth expansion tiers need Spaceflight, Flower Planet, Mineral Planet and Ocean Planet. Buy Spaceflight after Parallel Drones, Modules, Dictionaries and Irrigation. Flower Planet costs2000 pumpkin; Ocean Planet20000 carrot; Mineral Planet5000 cactus. Exterior surfaces expand using local produce: price20×next stage squared, paid in rose,carp or stone. No elapsed-time certificate forces a wait.
entries.zh: 地球扩张、执行速度和增产仍有原有作物发现门槛；最后四次扩张分别需要星际航行、花卉、矿物、海洋星球。星际航行需要并行无人机、模块、字典和灌溉。花卉星球消耗2000南瓜，海洋星球20000胡萝卜，矿物星球5000仙人掌。外星表层按20×下一级平方付费，以当地玫瑰、鲤鱼或石头支付。没有强制等待时长认证。

entries.source: 保留林木间距、伴生、水分感染、巨型南瓜与死亡替换、太阳花花瓣优先级、仙人掌排序连收、连通迷宫、长尾与骨头结算。宝藏产出coins金币，gold现在专指黄金锭。作物移动遵守球面边界，巡田须查询矩形宽高并返回起点；扩张不再清除原有作物。
entries.en: Keep original crop mechanics: tree spacing, companions, water and infection; giant pumpkin squares, dead replacements; sunflower petal priority; sorted cactus regions; connected mazes; dinosaur tails and bone settlement. Treasure produces coins, while gold is a refined mineral. Crop movement now respects spherical edges. Re-read rectangular extents and reset to the beginning after a sweep. Expanded grids preserve planted crops.

entries.source: 游戏解释器是明确记录的Python子集，不是系统Python。支持循环、条件、函数、闭包、默认值、位置参数、集合、模块和返回值；不提供操作系统、文件、网络、标准库访问，也不支持异常捕获与关键字参数。新增sum、enumerate、zip、sorted、reversed、round、all、any、pow、divmod、type、Unicode和字符串方法，逐项见接口说明。集合操作返回快照列表，而非Python惰性迭代器或视图；数值使用统一表示。
entries.en: The game interpreter is a documented subset, not system Python. It supports loops, conditionals, functions, closures, defaults, positional arguments, collections, modules and return values. It has no OS/file/network/stdlib access, exceptions or keyword arguments. New sum/enumerate/zip/sorted/reversed/round/all/any/pow/divmod/type/Unicode helpers and string methods are documented individually. Collection operations return snapshots rather than Python lazy iterators/views. Numbers use a shared numeric representation.

entries.source: 顶栏包含宇宙、殖民地、科技、程序、手册、UFO、纪录、设置。程序中心目标与文件独立滚动。每台载具、每个星球管理和宇宙总控各最多一个解释器；仅绑定会停止旧代码并关联文件，绑定运行会启动。浏览其他文件不会替换已有执行。绿色表示运行，琥珀边框表示编辑，至少保留一个文件，支持数字和中文名称。
entries.en: Top navigation opens Universe, Colony, Research, Programs, Manual, UFO, Records and Settings. Program center targets and files scroll independently. A worker, a planet manager and the universe controller each have at most one interpreter. Bind only stops and associates; Bind+run starts. Browsing another file never replaces running code. Green means running; an amber border means editing. At least one file remains. Numeric and Chinese file names are supported.

entries.source: 地球是无人机，芳华是小蜜蜂，沧澜是渔船，鎏金是采矿无人机，均不能跨星球。各星球有独立slotTier数量和hullTier尺寸变量，分别付费研究。1×1、2×1、2×2、3×2、3×3占据真实格子，必须能放进已开放范围；路径检查完整占地，拥堵时等待。蜜蜂扇翅、无人机转旋翼、渔船转推进器、矿机转钻头。
entries.en: Earth has drones, Floralia bees, Pelagia fishing boats, Aurelia mining drones. They cannot change planets. Each planet has separate slotTier and hullTier variables; both require paid local research. Hulls1×1,2×1,2×2,3×2,3×3 occupy real cells and must fit unlocked space. Worker paths reserve full footprints and queue when blocked. Bees flap wings, drones spin rotors, boats animate propellers and mining drones animate drills.

entries.source: 蜜蜂管理玫瑰、郁金香、薰衣草、百合、兰花、荷花，蜂蜜使用玫瑰花源收集。一格可种玫瑰，郁金香／薰衣草需要宽度2，百合／兰花／荷花需要宽度4。水和堆肥通过UFO送达；兰花需要白银，荷花需要鱼粉。投入和产出乘机体面积，耗时乘0.8＋0.2×sqrt(面积)。
entries.en: Bees manage rose,tulip,lavender,lily,orchid and lotus batches; honey is collected from rose resources. Rose works on the first plot, tulip/lavender need width2, and lily/orchid/lotus width4. Water and compost arrive by UFO. Orchids need refined silver; lotus needs fishmeal. Inputs and outputs scale with hull area, while batch time uses0.8+0.2×sqrt(area).

entries.source: 渔船用鱼饵捕获鲤鱼、鳟鱼、鲑鱼、鳕鱼、金枪鱼、锦鲤，锦鲤还需荷花。鱼群有空间分布，planet_scan可查种类，渔船会先前往相应已开放格再作业。扩展表层才可接触更多鱼群。鱼粉由鲤鱼加工，不存在无原料、无耗时直接赠鱼的调用。
entries.en: Boats catch carp,trout,salmon,cod,tuna and koi using fish feed; koi also require lotus. Shoals are spatial: planet_scan reveals the species and a boat navigates to a matching accessible cell before processing. More species become available as the surface expands. Fishmeal processes caught carp. None of these functions creates free fish without input or time.

entries.source: 采矿产出石头、铜矿石、锡矿石、银矿石、金矿石、铂矿石和金刚石原石，采矿无人机会前往对应矿脉。冶炼产出铜锭、锡锭、青铜、白银和黄金锭；铂金需精炼，钻石需切割。青铜消耗3铜锭＋1锡锭＋太阳能，不是石头。铂金需要玫瑰，切钻需要兰花。本版矿脉为可重复批次资源，每批采矿和冶炼均支付相应能量。
entries.en: Mining produces stone, copper_ore,tin_ore,silver_ore,gold_ore,platinum_ore and rough_diamond. Native drones navigate to matching deposits. Smelting produces copper,tin,bronze,silver,gold; platinum is refined and diamond is cut. Bronze consumes3 copper+1 tin+solar energy, not stone. Platinum needs roses and diamond cutting needs orchids. Deposits are renewable batch sources in this edition; energy is consumed for each mining/refining batch.

entries.source: 只有UFO能跨星球转移物资。地球建造需50资金＋20木材＋10太阳能，初始120电量。发射同时预留整批库存与电量：ceil(数量/载荷)×(2＋星球编号距离)。每航段耗时12＋6×编号距离秒。载荷24／72／144／288与数量1～4分别用回运青铜、白银、铂金研究。只能用当前停靠星球的太阳能充电，每份补5，上限1000。取消立即退回未装载库存；在途货物安全完成当前航段并存入目的地。
entries.en: Only UFOs move items between planets. Build costs50 credits+20wood+10solar energy on Earth and provides120 battery. Launch atomically reserves full stock and battery: ceil(amount/capacity)×(2+planet-ID distance). Each flight leg lasts12+6×planet-ID distance seconds. Capacities24,72,144,288 and1–4 ships are researched independently using returned bronze/silver/platinum. Refuel at the current dock with local solar energy:5 battery/unit, maximum1000. Cancel refunds unused stock immediately; airborne cargo finishes its current leg and deposits at destination.

entries.source: swarm_create为同一星球的不同载具编号建立命名集群，可有多个集群；同一文件可作为多个独立副本运行。变量和模块状态隔离，消息深拷贝，收件箱最多16条；fleet_receive非阻塞，空时None。跨星球协作由各星球管理和宇宙总控安排。
entries.en: swarm_create names unique worker IDs from one planet. Several groups may coexist, and one file can run as independent copies. Variables and module instances are isolated; messages are deep-copied and inboxes hold16 values. fleet_receive is nonblocking and returns None when empty. Use separate planet managers and a universe program to coordinate different swarms.

entries.en: Create the 11-file universe example. Run universe_controller on Universe; it launches managers for unlocked planets. Each manager binds its native starter worker. Parent completion does not stop children. Managers do not consume worker slots. Worker errors stop only that interpreter. Physical work queues may continue after code stops; use worker_cancel or stop_all deliberately.

entries.en: 0.13.1 saves are isolated under Automation/Universe0131. Old farm files are retained and not silently converted into a different universe. Save physical cargo, queues, battery, surfaces, swarms and file bindings. Interpreter stacks,inboxes and result objects are transient; restart controllers after loading and inspect existing queues. Original race farms remain separate. Ctrl/Cmd+Z undo, Shift+Ctrl/Cmd+Z redo, F9 breakpoints and external editing remain.

entries.en: Every retained Earth function and Python-inspired helper has an individual entry below, including defaults, results and examples. Keys are case-sensitive. No keyword arguments. get_world_size is a compatibility width query, not a rectangular height.

entries.source: universe_用于宇宙管理，planet_用于星球，worker_用于本地载具，swarm_用于本地集群，ufo_专用于星际货运。保留的fleet_／island_仅为兼容名称，单独标记说明。fleet_ship与fleet_rebase已移除，不是瞬移捷径。
entries.en: Use universe_ for global management, planet_ for a colony, worker_ for native craft, swarm_ for local groups and ufo_ exclusively for interplanetary freight. Kept fleet_/island_ names are compatibility spellings and are documented separately. fleet_ship and fleet_rebase are retired, not teleport shortcuts.

entries.source: 每个专属函数精确对应一份本地配方，调用只排队，不会立即免费发放物资。下方配方来自实际运行数据。coins金币、gold_ore金矿石、gold黄金锭严格区分，原矿和成品使用不同库存编号。
entries.en: Each product function maps to exactly one native recipe. It enqueues work, never an immediate free item. The recipe table below is exported from the runtime. Distinguish coins, gold_ore and gold; raw minerals and refined products are separate inventory IDs.

entries.en: Green: production · blue: automation · amber: ecology · violet: transport. Dark nodes are locked; bright nodes are researched.

entries.source: 请先在宇宙科技中解锁此星球。

entries.zh: 请先在宇宙科技中解锁此星球。

entries.en: Your orbital mothership connects four worlds. Choose Earth to descend.
entries.zh: 轨道母舰连接四颗星球。选择地球，乘穿梭机降落。

entries.source: 为本地载具绑定生产程序。
entries.en: Assign a production program to your local worker.
entries.zh: 为本地载具绑定生产程序。

entries.source: 研究与全部宇宙项目均已完成。
entries.en: Research and all universe projects complete.
entries.zh: 研究与全部宇宙项目均已完成。

entries.en: Every interplanetary route docks at the mothership. Use depot −1 to store and retrieve goods there.

entries.zh: 消耗当前泊位20太阳能，补充100电量。

entries.zh: 用花卉蜂蜜与海洋鱼粉支持地球生态工程。

entries.source: 钻石依赖开采、花卉、白银和切割，请组织独立集群。
entries.en: Diamonds require mining, flowers, silver and cutting; run independent swarms.
entries.zh: 钻石依赖开采、花卉、白银和切割，请组织独立集群。

entries.source: 在母舰建立六种花卉的均衡种质储备。
entries.en: Build a balanced six-species reserve in the mothership.
entries.zh: 在母舰建立六种花卉的均衡种质储备。

entries.source: 联合交付鱼类和精炼金属，同时维持殖民地原料。
entries.en: Deliver fish and refined metals together without starving the colonies.
entries.zh: 联合交付鱼类和精炼金属，同时维持殖民地原料。

entries.source: 维持稀有矿石加工，并同时供应普通金属。
entries.en: Sustain rare-ore processing alongside ordinary metal supply.
entries.zh: 维持稀有矿石加工，并同时供应普通金属。

entries.source: 平衡各星球本地仓库与轨道仓库的生命保障物资。
entries.en: Balance local and orbital depots across every planet.
entries.zh: 平衡各星球本地仓库与轨道仓库的生命保障物资。

entries.source: 联合交付花卉、海洋及矿物的特色展品组合。
entries.en: Deliver a curated botanical, marine and mineral collection.
entries.zh: 联合交付花卉、海洋及矿物的特色展品组合。

entries.source: 以工业规模生产并运输相互依赖的供应网络。
entries.en: Produce and transport an interdependent supply network at industrial scale.
entries.zh: 以工业规模生产并运输相互依赖的供应网络。

entries.source: 向母舰完成最后一组联合交付，让四星供应链形成完整闭环。
entries.en: Complete the final simultaneous delivery to your mothership.
entries.zh: 向母舰完成最后一组联合交付，让四星供应链形成完整闭环。

entries.source: 未解锁星球显示为灰色，各星球沿随机独立轴旋转。选择已开放星球，穿梭机从母舰降落。本地载具不会跨星球，所有跨星UFO航线经过母舰。仓库编号−1用于存入与提取母舰物资。取消任务时，在途货物停靠当前航段目标，可能进入母舰；补能必须使用当前泊位太阳能。
entries.en: Locked worlds appear grey, each rotating on its own randomized axis. Select an unlocked planet to watch the shuttle descend from the mothership. Native workers stay local. Every interplanetary UFO route passes through the mother; use depot -1 to store and retrieve supplies. Cancellation deposits airborne cargo at its next dock, which may be the mother. Local solar energy is required to refuel.

entries.source: 科技分为宇宙、地球、花卉、海洋和矿物分区，星球解锁位于宇宙分区。绿色生产、蓝色自动化、橙色生态、紫色运输；暗色未研究，亮色已购买。专属科技真实改变配方耗时或产量，每项五级，费用逐级翻倍。作物形态连续生长，小农场默认近景；收获特效使用有数量上限的共享池。大地图筛选背面和远处作物块，并批量绘制可见实例。流程不设置固定等待时间门槛。
entries.en: Research has Universe, Earth, Flower, Ocean and Mineral sectors. Planet discovery is in Universe. Green is production, blue automation, amber ecology, violet transport. Dark nodes are unresearched; bright nodes have a purchased level. Native research changes real recipe speed/yields; costs double per level, five levels per branch. Growth now changes crop shape continuously. A close-up is selected for small fields; harvest bursts use a bounded shared pool. Full-size surfaces cull distant/back-facing crop chunks and batch the visible instances. There is no fixed campaign timer gate.

entries.source: 0.13.2存档隔离在Automation/Universe0131，旧农场保留，不会静默转换成另一套宇宙。保存实体货物、队列、电量、表层、集群和绑定文件；调用栈、收件箱和结果不保存。读档后检查已有队列再重启总控。本地竞速仍是独立预设。保留撤销重做、F9断点和外部编辑器。
entries.en: 0.13.2 saves are isolated under Automation/Universe0131. Old farm files are retained and not silently converted into a different universe. Save physical cargo, queues, battery, surfaces, swarms and file bindings. Interpreter stacks,inboxes and result objects are transient; restart controllers after loading and inspect existing queues. Original race farms remain separate. Ctrl/Cmd+Z undo, Shift+Ctrl/Cmd+Z redo, F9 breakpoints and external editing remain.
